calibration_source: Approximate visual 24h uptake readings, not raw data. Fitting is not validation.

decisions.capacity: N_j = fitted accessible cell count times literal paper population frequency; total surface = N_j * geometric area
decisions.clearance: Explicit binding/internalisation handles target-mediated removal. Background CL=Vc*ln(2)/(21*24) L/h is our assumption, not a Mould fitted parameter or terminal half-life of the two-compartment system.
decisions.no_double_counting: No empirical Mould target-related Michaelis-Menten elimination on top of explicit target removal.
decisions.volume: Effective intracellular fraction of a 10um sphere, fitted once and frozen across densities.
decisions.dissociation: q1=koff1*sqrt(r), q2=koff2/sqrt(r), r=kon2*k2d1/(kon1*k2d2). Symmetric detailed balance is our extension.
decisions.search: Two seeded NSGAII runs then constrained SLSQP. Best verified feasible candidate, not certified global optimum.
decisions.domain: Broad engineering domain, not author-reported bounds or demonstrated engineering reachability.
decisions.toxicity: Weighted Emax at 24h. Nominal limit 0.95% gives numerical headroom, not robustness assurance.
